title: Bootstrap flywheel-first planning repository
objective: Establish the minimal cold-start, canonical spec, work graph, evidence, memory, triage, and doctor surfaces.
acceptance: Cold agent has one obvious entry point
Work graph is machine-readable
Generated frontier names one highest-value READY item
Doctor can detect malformed work graph state
strongest_falsifier: A fresh agent must recursively read the repository or guess what work is current.

title: Import complete Rising Sea planning corpus with provenance
objective: Ingest the existing Rising Sea planning artifacts as immutable source material without turning historical documents into current authority.
acceptance: Every imported source has path or URI, SHA-256, source kind, and disposition
Current and historical planning artifacts remain distinguishable
No source is silently rewritten during import
A source inventory can be regenerated deterministically
Every source required for downstream compilation is retrieval-complete for a fresh agent
strongest_falsifier: An imported document cannot be traced back to its exact original bytes or a stable independently retrievable external reference.
next_action: Read evidence/receipts/RS-W001.json; retrieval completeness continues in RS-W001B.
partial_reason: 19 source records are hash-bound and deterministically indexed, but all are REGISTERED_ONLY and their chatgpt-artifact origins are not independently retrievable from a fresh GitHub-only context.

title: Make registered Rising Sea corpus retrieval-complete
objective: Ensure every source needed for canonical-spec compilation is either vendored byte-for-byte in the repository or points to a stable independently retrievable external object with an anchored digest.
acceptance: No source needed by RS-W002 remains REGISTERED_ONLY
Every VENDORED source rehashes to the registry SHA-256
Every EXTERNAL source has a stable independently retrievable URI and anchored digest
Large bundle sources may be represented by retrieval-complete constituent artifacts rather than duplicated archives when the mapping is explicit
A fresh GitHub-only agent can obtain every source required to compile current specs
strongest_falsifier: A source required by RS-W002 can only be recovered from prior chat context or an unavailable transient artifact URI.
next_action: Vendor the current v2 semantic source set first, update source availability and repo_path, then mechanically identify any historical sources still required by RS-W002.

title: Compile imported corpus into canonical current specs
objective: Reduce the imported corpus to one current semantic representation per durable concept while retaining citations and supersession links.
acceptance: One canonical current representation per durable concept
Historical sources remain recoverable
Conflicting claims are explicit
UNKNOWN is preserved
Canonical specs cite source IDs
strongest_falsifier: Two current pages independently claim authority over the same semantic object without an explicit relationship.

title: Compile dependency-aware implementation work graph
objective: Turn canonical specs into self-contained implementation packets with explicit dependencies, witnesses, falsifiers, and acceptance criteria.
acceptance: Workers do not need the original corpus
Dependency graph is acyclic or cycles are explicit failures
Every ready packet has testable acceptance criteria
Critical path and blockers are mechanically derivable
strongest_falsifier: A worker must infer a hidden dependency or reread historical planning prose to execute a packet.

title: Run matched cold-agent flywheel navigation benchmark
objective: Measure whether the repository actually reduces context, navigation, recovery, and decision cost rather than assuming ergonomics from design.
acceptance: Matched tasks use fixed success criteria
Pages read, tokens, errors, time-to-next-action, and recovery are measured separately
No scalar winner is asserted without explicit weights
strongest_falsifier: The flywheel surface consumes equal or greater resources without improving correctness or recoverability.
next_action: Blocked until a real work graph exists.
